notes: P3: Row (10c-spec §7). tx = -max(0, (index - LEAD) * step), LEAD = 1: cards 0 and 1 both rest at offset 0; card 2 rests at -step.

The local library (profile Claude QA, 2026-10-10): row 0 = Continue Watching (frame cards, step 238), row 1 = Recommended for You (posters, step 138), row 2 = New Movies (posters, 20 items). 'offset-N' = focus on card N of row 2.

A traced move is made FROM REST (a wait:800 before the last key): the native row retargets inside the focus change and the JS row a frame or more later, so a spring that is still travelling when the next key lands is at a different point in the two — by design — and only a segment that starts at rest is the same curve.
Bursts (KEY*N@50) carry "traceRule": "rest": the gaps of an adb burst are not reproducible (trace.py compare_rest), so a burst is judged by its rest pixels, its rest value and its focus table.
focusCheck: the [focus] tables must be the same sequence (react tags renamed in order of first focus — trace.py _canon).
